subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about the roadmap for FintechCo's automated customer summaries. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can get you an accurate hosted-API price estimate: 

- Ask: can you confirm expected monthly token volume (rough order of magnitude is fine: e.g., 50M, 200M, 1B tokens/month)?
- Ask: what’s the expected peak TPS (concurrent requests at the busiest minute)?
- Ask: do you have a target unit cost per 1M tokens (ballpark $/1M) or monthly budget range we should aim for?

From the call notes: you plan to start with a private beta in June (ingesting ~6K customers/day) and move to production in Q4. We want to size both the initial and steady-state. I’ve attached a simple usage worksheet — if you can drop numbers in there it helps our pricing team run scenarios.

Attachment: projected_usage_q2.xlsx (usage template)

Tentative next steps: once you share the numbers I’ll run two hosted-API scenarios (on-demand pricing vs 12-month committed tier + reserved throughput) and share a short comparison with expected monthly spend and recommended configuration (batching, cache TTLs, peak routing).

If it helps, here are the specific fields our pricing team finds most helpful in the sheet: monthly active users, average tokens per request, expected requests/minute peak, and whether you require low-latency (<200ms) vs throughput-optimized.

Thanks — I’ll block 30 mins next Tue as a follow-up; feel free to push back if earlier is better.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference for production
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the template. I filled out the sheet and attached it (projected_usage_q2.xlsx). Key numbers below for quick reference:

- Expected monthly token volume (steady-state, Q4): ~200,000,000 tokens/month
- Initial beta (June) expected: ~20,000,000 tokens/month
- Peak TPS: we see spikes during statement-release windows; estimate peak sustained minute-level TPS ~45 TPS (mostly afternoon business hours)
- Average tokens per request: ~1,200 tokens (summary + metadata)
- Target unit economics: we're aiming for ~$8–$12 / 1M tokens (this is an internal target to keep feature economics attractive)
- Monthly budget: expect to be in the $1.5k–$3k range initially, with ability to expand if unit price/performance is favorable

Notes: latency is important for end-user flows (~<250ms tail preferred), but for async batches (end-of-day summarization) we can tolerate higher latency if it reduces cost. We plan to use hosted API for real-time features initially, and potentially Dedicated later if traffic grows significantly.

Let me know if you need more granularity on concurrent connections or distribution across request sizes. Happy to jump on another quick call.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of ML Infrastructure, FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

Attachment: projected_usage_q2.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Alex —

Perfect, this is exactly what we need. Based on the Q4 steady-state numbers (200M tokens/month, 45 TPS peak, avg 1,200 tokens/request) I’ll run two ballpark scenarios for Hosted API tomorrow:

1) On-demand pricing (no commit) — conservative estimate to expect ~ $12–$15 / 1M tokens given the payload size and latency SLO.
2) 12-month committed tier + reserved throughput — with a modest commit we can get to ~$8–$10 / 1M tokens and provide a guaranteed throughput profile to smooth peaks (helps with your 45 TPS spikes).

A couple of clarifying Qs before I finalize the scenarios:
- Are you open to a 12-month commit if the unit price is in the ~$8/1M range?
- For the real-time flow, do you expect a hard tail latency requirement at 95th/99th percentile? If so, what target (e.g., 250ms p95)?

Next steps I propose: I’ll send a short comparison doc (2 slides + cost table) and a sample quote for the committed tier. If that looks good we can spin up a short Proof-of-Concept (2–4 weeks) on Hosted API with throttling policies set for your peak profile. If POC numbers look good, we’ll convert to a 12-month commit and provision reserved capacity.

I’ll attach the cost scenarios and proposed next-meeting invite in the next email.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
